description: Source code for decoding LWM2M SenML data encoded in CBOR format using zcbor library; includes functions for decoding various record types and the overall structure.

methods.name: decode_repeated_record_bn
methods.description: Decodes a 'record_bn' type from CBOR data, expecting an integer and a string.

methods.name: decode_repeated_record_bt
methods.description: Decodes a 'record_bt' type, expecting an integer and a 64-bit integer within range.

methods.name: decode_repeated_record_n
methods.description: Decodes a 'record_n' type, expecting an unsigned integer and a string.

methods.name: decode_repeated_record_t
methods.description: Decodes a 'record_t' type, expecting an unsigned integer and a 64-bit integer within range.

methods.name: decode_repeated_record_union
methods.description: Decodes a union type with multiple possible data types, including int, float, string, bool, and binary.

methods.name: decode_value
methods.description: Decodes a 'value_r' union type, which can be string, binary, int, float, or bool.

methods.name: decode_key_value_pair
methods.description: Decodes a key-value pair consisting of an integer key and a value.

methods.name: decode_record
methods.description: Decodes a 'record' structure containing optional fields and nested records.

methods.name: decode_lwm2m_senml
methods.description: Decodes a list of 'record' structures into a 'lwm2m_senml' structure.

methods.name: cbor_decode_lwm2m_senml
methods.description: Entry point function to decode CBOR payload into lwm2m_senml structure.
